item.title: About Me
item.description: I’m Jordan Parra - a bilingual, analytical data professional with 3+ years of experience in statistical modeling, research analysis, and data-driven decision-making within small-business environments. I specialize in translating data concepts and machine learning techniques into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders. Proficient in Python, SQL, and data visualization, translating complex data insights into practical recommendations that support business objectives. Collaborative team player with hands-on leadership experience, strong communication skills, and a proven ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
